question: What is worshipped as the wheel of consciousness-waves in the Lord?
premises: The Lord of consciousness has an inner creative intuition.
That intuition takes form as a body or manifestation.
The manifestation may appear as gentle or as another measured form.
inference: Therefore the wheel of consciousness-waves worshipped is the inner creative intuition of the one Lord taking such forms.
uncertainties: Whether vānyanmitaṃ contrasts gentle with fierce or with any limited form is not fully explicit.
plain_english: The inner creative intuition of the one Lord of consciousness is his own body; as a gentle or other measured form, it is worshipped as the wheel of waves of consciousness.
